question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(date) as last_race_date
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
last_race_ids AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.race_id
    FROM races r
    JOIN last_race lr ON r.year = lr.year AND r.date = lr.last_race_date
),
top_drivers AS (
    SELECT lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_race_ids lr ON ds.race_id = lr.race_id
    WHERE ds.position = 1
),
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_race_ids lr ON cs.race_id = lr.race_id
    WHERE cs.position = 1
)
SELECT td.year,
       d.full_name,
       td.driver_points,
       CAST(tc.constructor_id AS INTEGER) as constructor_id,
       c.name as constructor_name,
       tc.constructor_points
FROM top_drivers td
JOIN drivers_ext d ON td.driver_id = d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN top_constructors tc ON td.year = tc.year
LEFT JOIN constructors c ON tc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY td.year
